summary: Ollama provides a runtime environment to download, configure, and execute large language models locally on your own hardware. It abstracts the underlying model files and execution libraries into a standardised interface for text generation tasks.
goodFor: Developers and system administrators who want to run generative AI models locally without relying on external cloud APIs.
watchOut: Running large language models locally demands substantial hardware resources, particularly compatible GPUs with sufficient VRAM for acceptable performance.
deployNotes: As a containerised application, it typically requires persistent storage volumes to save downloaded model weights and a reverse proxy if you need to handle TLS termination for network access.
